reported.title: barcode is_valid uses 'or' so any 13-digit barcode is valid

reported.claim: The early return `if m >= len(text)` wrongly returns -1 when the pattern has exactly the same length as the text, even when the pattern equals the text.
reported.title: bitap_string_match fails when pattern length equals text length

reported.claim: When the weighted subtotal is divisible by 10 the checksum becomes 10 instead of 0, so valid PESEL numbers with check digit 0 are rejected.
reported.title: is_polish_national_id checksum 10 instead of 0

reported.claim: The swap condition uses '<=' instead of '<', so two words of equal length swap back and forth forever and the recursion never terminates.
reported.title: levenshtein_distance_optimized infinite recursion on equal lengths

reported.claim: The function returns the last loop variable `word` (a string) instead of the `occurrence` dictionary of counts.
reported.title: word_occurrence returns last word instead of counts
